current_goal_turn_classification: progress on the actual Wilson route: exact finite-cylinder reduction and full-Haar compatibility; no numerical upper or lower obligation closed
scope: The actual finite Wilson boundary messages, with their true spatial endpoint weight, converge uniformly to a positive multiple of the constructed ground after transfer normalization and one smoothing step. Their distant mixed ratios converge to the literal ground farCost, and depth-uniform bounds pass unchanged at fixed spatial cutoff. The input spatial factors cancel exactly for disjoint affected plaquettes, leaving a finite output partition with no unknown ground boundary. Central-slice finite-cylinder variances and the matching full-Haar energies converge to their actual ground-law versions; a common direct coercivity constant passes unchanged. Averaging complete Haar rotation assignments gives precisely the total Haar energy without a link-count factor. Consequently finite-cylinder upper and lower estimates imply actual physical-transfer slab contraction with A*(16*D+R)/(k+A*(16*D+R)). This is an exact reduction, not a proof of the depth- and spatially uniform numerical R and A. All twelve full Clay obligations remain open.

formal_results.actual_boundary: B_0=W and B_(j+1)=T B_j; positivity and gauge invariance are proved. Temporal gauge averaging is removed only against this invariant message.
formal_results.uniform_limit: lambda^(-(j+1))*B_(j+1) tends uniformly to overlap*g. The existing fixed-cutoff L2 boundary limit is composed with the bounded kernel smoothing operator; overlap and lambda are strictly positive.
formal_results.finite_partition: Z_j(u)=integral C(u,v)*W(v)*B_j(v) dHaar(v); B_(j+1)(u)=W(u)*Z_j(u). For distinct links with disjoint affected spatial plaquettes, the mixed B ratio equals Z_j(u)*Z_j(R_e R_d u)/(Z_j(R_e u)*Z_j(R_d u))-1 exactly.
formal_results.far_limit: The sum of absolute finite mixed B ratios over the complement of near(e) tends to the actual ground farCost. The common scalar transfer and overlap factors cancel. Any depth-uniform R passes with the same value at each fixed cutoff.
formal_results.lower_limit: Central finite-cylinder variance is identified with ProbabilityTheory.variance under the original Wilson cylinder law. Its mean, variance and the full-Haar energy converge to the corresponding true ground-law quantities.
formal_results.coercivity: If centralVar_j(F)<=A*centralEnergy_j(F) for every j and continuous gauge-invariant F, then Var_pi(F)<=A*totalEnergy_pi(F) with the same A.
formal_results.haar_binding: The product-Haar average of sum_e responseEnergy(e,q_e;F) is exactly totalEnergy(F). Integrating the all-assignment bound yields totalEnergy(PF)<=(16*D+R)*loss(F), with no link-count multiplier.
formal_results.contraction: For physical F and k>0, Var_pi(P^k F)<=A*(16*D+R)/(k+A*(16*D+R))*Var_pi(F), under the explicit finite-cylinder hypotheses. D can be instantiated by the previously proved (exp(8*beta)-1)^2.

next_attack.required_upper: Prove a summable connected-insertion bound uniform in finite depth, spatial period, baseline boundary and the entire source rectangle, including large-field histories. Preserve the actual finite endpoint weights and source normalizers.
next_attack.required_lower: Prove a variance comparison for central marginals of the same finite Wilson cylinders on physical observables, with a constant uniform in cylinder depth and sufficiently controlled in spatial period and coupling. Local density bounds alone do not provide this.
next_attack.physical_budget: Track A*(16*D+R)/k for k corresponding to fixed physical time. Remove exponential coupling losses if this budget diverges on the justified trajectory. A finite-cutoff strict ratio alone is not a physical mass gap.
next_attack.stop_repeating: Do not re-prove boundary-to-ground passage or replace the two actual numerical estimates with additional conditional wrappers. The new theorem already supplies their common contraction conclusion.

not_inferred: No depth- and spatially uniform numerical bound R on the actual finite-boundary far sum, or its ground limit, has been obtained.
No depth- and spatially uniform direct Haar coercivity constant A for the actual central Wilson slices has been obtained. The limiting argument does not establish that estimate.
The all-rotation upper hypothesis is essential for the product-Haar averaging argument. A bound only on selected small rotations does not give the full-Haar conclusion.

The explicit all-rotation local cap D=(exp(8*beta)-1)^2 grows exponentially in beta. A bounded contraction factor on fixed physical time slabs requires control of A*(16*D+R)/k along a justified physical trajectory.

Boundary convergence is used only at fixed spatial period and coupling. Neither a uniform vacuum-convergence rate nor an interchange with the spatial or continuum limit is proved or required for this reduction.

Finite-cylinder normalization, the true ground boundary limit and response-family compatibility are now bound exactly, but the connected-correlation estimates, global coercivity, nontrivial continuum survival and all twelve Clay requirements remain open.
